standard_prerequisites: the completion-functor situation of the section: f : X' -> X with T' the inverse image of T, U' = f^{-1}U, and the morphism of formal completions f_{/T} : X'_{/T'} -> X_{/T} with its cartesian diagram

adic morphisms from Spf(R) of a complete discrete valuation ring into a formal completion and their algebraization to morphisms of schemes (Formal Spaces, Lemma formal-spaces-lemma-adic-into-completion)
the valuative criterion of properness for algebraic spaces (Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-characterize-proper)
existence of a discrete valuation ring R' with fraction field K' dominating a given DVR R (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-exists-dvr)
the completion of a discrete valuation ring is a complete discrete valuation ring (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-completion-dvr)
rig-surjectivity of a morphism of formal algebraic spaces: every adic test morphism from a complete DVR lifts after passing to an extension
core_obligations: Prove that if X is locally Noetherian, f : X' -> X is proper, and U' -> U is surjective, then f_{/T} : X'_{/T'} -> X_{/T} is rig-surjective
proof_roadmap: Given an adic morphism p : Spf(R) -> X_{/T} with R a complete DVR, algebraize it: the composition Spf(R) -> X_{/T} -> X corresponds to a morphism q : Spec(R) -> X mapping Spec(K) into U.

Surjectivity of U' -> U makes Spec(K) x_U U' nonempty and proper over K; after a field extension K'/K choose a K'-point of U', take a DVR R' dominating R with fraction field K', and extend the K'-point to a morphism Spec(R') -> X' over Spec(R) -> X by the valuative criterion of properness.
The inverse image of T' in Spec(R') is the closed point, so the morphism induces an adic morphism Spf((R')^wedge) -> X'_{/T'} lifting p, noting that (R')^wedge is again a complete DVR.
difficulty_reason: H3: a valuative-criterion argument that algebraizes the formal test object, lifts a generic point through the surjection, and closes the curve to produce the required formal lift.
